hooks.command: [ "$(git rev-parse --git-dir)" = "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" ] && echo "Note: this session is in the main checkout, not a worktree. If another agent may be working in this repo, offer to work in a worktree on a new branch (EnterWorktree) so edits do not mix; if the user is working alone, carry on. Either way, check that the current branch ($(git branch --show-current)) fits this task before committing, and explain any git step in plain words." || true
